messages:
jasmin.peopleops: Heads up 8:47pm9  courier dropped a long box + 3 small pots by the planter bench. Box stamped 'Vintage Lamp - Handle Vertical' and pots labeled 'Studio Props'. No recipient on manifest. Anyone available to secure them in Supply Closet 1? :bulb: :seedling:
lee: I'm nearby. Can take the dolly and move them in 5. Should we leave the lamp upright or on its side? 
toni: Upright, please. Box has brittle seam tape. I can bring a tarp 60 to protect the bench  also theres a note: small drip on one pot.
frontdesk-bot: Automated: Unidentified delivery scanned at 20:46 by LobbyCam-1. Recommended action: hold for 72h. Pending visitor approvals: 1 (11:15 host: @lee).
ravi: If the host is @lee and the visitor listed is "set-up crew" please pre-approve a temp badge labelled 'Setup - Observe only' to speed sign-in.
jasmin.peopleops: @frontdesk-bot please pre-print that badge and place it in Drawer A2. Also tag the box with STORED-2129 and note crate key attached to tape.
frontdesk-bot: Badge printed: BadgeID 9347. Placed Drawer A2. Note added: STORED-2129.
suzanne: Photo uploaded: https://files.redwood/lamp-pots.jpg 4f7 Label reads "Vintage Lamp - Handle Vertical". Tiny sticky on pot #2: "watered 2x". Key taped to box flap labeled 'shelf-3'.
lee: Moved items to Supply Closet 1. Left key in Drawer A2. Tarp placed under lamp. Wiped soil from bench. :white_check_mark:
toni: Thanks  I'll bring an extra folding table for the demo area if the crew needs it. Also who wants kombucha tomorrow morning? I have a 6-pack. :beverage_box:
ravi: I'll take a can. Also adding note to visitor log: "confirm crate key on arrival".
jasmin.peopleops: Perfect. If no host confirmation by 10:45 we'll hold the items and mark for return to shipper. Whoever does the morning mail sweep, please check Supply Closet 1 and post a photo here for chain-of-custody. First coffee to whoever helps move the lamp if it needs re-positioning. :coffee:
